title: AgeOfOrigin
body:
**🌍 AgeOfOrigin**

**Evolve Your Survival Experience**

![age](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7f827b4a4e3f485ba465c6cb2828ecec3c35706e_0.webp)

AgeOfOrigin adds a linear progression system to your Minecraft SMP. Instead of players rushing to Netherite in the first hour, they must progress through distinct "Ages" (Wood, Stone, Iron, etc.) by gathering resources and donating them to the server.
This plugin acts as a massive resource sink and objective system, giving your players a reason to grind, trade, and work together.

**✨ Key Features**

- 7 Distinct Ages: Guide players from the humble Wood Age all the way to the Netherite Age.
- Item Donation System: Players must "donate" specific resources relevant to their current age to level up.
- Inventory Management: Includes a /donate all command to instantly clear valid resources from inventory towards progression.
- Fully Configurable: Server owners can customize exactly which items are required for each age and how many are needed via config.yml.
- Visual Feedback: satisfying Title screen messages and sounds upon leveling up.
- Data Persistence: Uses lightweight flat-file storage (players.yml), so no database setup is required.
  
**🎮 How It Works**
- Check Progress: Players use /progress to see their current Age and how many items they need to advance.
- Gather Resources: If a player is in the Wood Age, they need to chop logs. If they are in the Iron Age, they need to mine Iron.
- Donate: Players hold the items and type /donate (or /donate all) to hand them in.
- Level Up: Once the requirement is met, the player advances to the next Age!

**📜 Commands**
- /progress - View your current Age and donation progress.
- /donate - Donate the item currently held in your main hand.
- /donate all - Automatically find and donate all valid items from your inventory.
- /setage <player> <age> - (Admin) Forcefully set a player's age.

**🔒 Permissions**   
- ageoforigin.admin - Required to use the /setage command.
  
**⚙️ Configuration**

You have full control over the economy of your server. Here is an example of the default configuration:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

donations:
  WOOD: 250      # Requires 250 logs
  STONE: 350     # Requires 350 stone/cobble
  DIAMOND: 350   # Requires 350 diamonds

donation_materials:
  WOOD:
    - OAK_LOG
    - BIRCH_LOG
  STONE:
    - COBBLESTONE
    - DEEPSLATE

</details>

**🛠️ Installation**

- Download the AgeOfOrigin.jar.
- Place it in your server's plugins folder.
- Restart your server.
- (Optional) Edit config.yml to tweak donation amounts to fit your server's difficulty.
